verdict.rationale: Martin documents event-driven background automation: email triage that automatically labels incoming emails and takes follow-up actions, proactive email drafting, and scheduled briefings and wake-up calls. Custom shortcuts trigger multi-step actions, but they appear to be invoked on command rather than by events. Nothing shows a user-authored if-event-then-action rule system across integrations. Missing for 10: a documented user-defined rule/trigger builder, event triggers beyond email (calendar, Slack, etc.), details on how triage rules are configured, and independent corroboration.
